title: Wire fieldwork::collections module into all three servers
description: All three servers build OrderedCollection JSON inline instead of using fieldwork::collections::build_collection/build_collection_page. Replace inline json!({type:OrderedCollection...}) with fieldwork builders. Also add pagination to outbox/followers/following endpoints in smallhold and gaja (broadside already has outbox pagination). close_reason: All 3 servers wired to fieldwork::collections. Outbox pagination added to smallhold+gaja. All 104 tests pass.
